t: A Personal Philosophy for Purpose, Play, and Resilience in the Age of AI
s: This article outlines a personal philosophy for intentional living, integrating ancient Japanese concepts (Ikigai, Shoshin, Hara Hachi Bu, Wabi-Sabi) with humor and narrative to cultivate resilience and find purpose amidst life's uncertainties.
